page_description: Manage what you owe and what others owe you in one place. Automate installments and get a heads-up before due dates.
list_empty_description: Add your first debt to get started — a credit card, a loan to a friend, or someone who owes you.
paymentMode_auto_hint: Monthly expenses are generated automatically from the installment schedule — you don't lift a finger.
paymentMode_manual_hint: You hit 'Add payment' each time you pay.
form_modalSubtitle: Core debt details and payment plan.
payment_modalSubtitle: How much did you pay on this debt?
payment_createTransactionLabel: Also record this as a transaction
payment_createTransactionHint_payable: When on: this amount is deducted from your main balance and added to your expenses.
payment_createTransactionHint_receivable: When on: this amount is added to your main balance and shows up in your income.
payment_invalidAmount: Amount can't exceed the remaining balance
delete_confirmBody: The {{title}} debt and all its payment history will be deleted. Any linked recurring rule will be cancelled. This can't be undone.
cancel_confirmBody: The debt will be moved to 'Cancelled' status; payments and history are kept. It won't show up as active anymore.
